title: Run held-out confirmatory conditions
frozenQuestion: Do the four S10-frozen contrasts reproduce on protected S08 confirmatory scenarios with prespecified multiplicity control and tighter primary-endpoint precision?

primaryEndpoints.screeningContextOnly: Continuing after a blocking failure had a positive success contrast in S10.
Stuck minus passive had a positive residual-error contrast in S10.
Permutation minus uniform had a small negative residual-error contrast in S10.
The coverage-selected weak-coordinator contrast was near-null but positive in S10; it must not be replaced or dropped.

secondaryEndpoints.orientation: active minus reference; log endpoints use log(value + 0.5) before differencing
secondaryEndpoints.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values over the 16 terminal secondary endpoint tests; descriptive effect sizes and intervals remain primary

pairingRules.unit: one protected S08 pairingBlockId shared by all four contrasts
pairingRules.selection: Outcome-blind deterministic SHA-256 allocation balances value-profile by order-structure cells, fault profiles, and policy-by-direction within each scale and nested look; every selected inputScenarioId is unique.
pairingRules.armRule: Execute the six distinct settings signatures represented by the eight frozen estimand arms on every selected block; reuse a run only when settings bytes and pairingBlockId are identical.
pairingRules.protectedScenarioRule: The exact maximum nested block list and all arm mappings are hashed before execution. No replacement, reassignment, or marginal change is permitted after outcome access.

multiplicityAndIntervals.method: At each look, a scale-stratified paired max-|t| bootstrap produces simultaneous two-sided intervals for all four primary effects at 99% family confidence. Bonferroni allocation of 0.01 to each of five possible looks bounds overall familywise error by 0.05.
multiplicityAndIntervals.bootstrapSeedRule: SHA-256 counter-addressed by confirmatory design-freeze hash, look, replicate, scale, and draw; worker order has no effect.
multiplicityAndIntervals.primaryPValues: two-sided max-|t| adjusted bootstrap tail probabilities at the terminal look; direction is interpreted only after applying the frozen sign
multiplicityAndIntervals.secondaryPValues: paired scale-stratified bootstrap sign-tail p-values with terminal Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment

sequentialRule.continueRule: After each look, continue all four contrasts to the next nested look if any primary simultaneous-interval half-width exceeds 0.015. Effect estimate, direction, significance, equivalence, success count, runtime, and secondary endpoints never trigger continuation or stopping.
sequentialRule.stopRule: Stop at or after 1000 blocks only when all four primary simultaneous-interval half-widths are at most 0.015.
sequentialRule.maximumRule: Stop after 5000 blocks regardless of precision. A primary contrast whose half-width still exceeds 0.015 is classified inconclusive_due_to_precision.
sequentialRule.runtimeRule: Runtime is not an adaptation criterion; any scientifically material reduction requires review.

terminalClassification.directionally_reproduced_material: The simultaneous interval excludes zero in the frozen direction and abs(estimate) is at least 0.02.
terminalClassification.directionally_reproduced_small: The simultaneous interval excludes zero in the frozen direction but abs(estimate) is below 0.02.
terminalClassification.practically_equivalent_to_zero: The simultaneous interval lies wholly inside [-0.02, 0.02] and does not exclude zero in the frozen direction.
terminalClassification.contradictory: The simultaneous interval excludes zero in the direction opposite the frozen direction.
terminalClassification.inconclusive: No directional or equivalence classification is supported by the simultaneous interval.
terminalClassification.inconclusive_due_to_precision: At the maximum look, the simultaneous half-width exceeds 0.015; this overrides other classifications.
terminalClassification.overlapRule: When a correctly directed interval excludes zero but remains wholly inside the equivalence margin, label directionally_reproduced_small and record practicalEquivalent=true.

escalationTriggers: any protected outcome access before this file and the exact nested design are frozen and hashed
any replacement, deletion, or direction change for E04, E06, E03, or E08
any protected scenario-ID, S08 coupling classification, arm marginal, or pairing change
any change to S02-S09 legal-action, information, scheduler, fault, replay, RNG, opportunity, or ledger contracts
any sampling adaptation based on observed effect size, direction, significance, success count, runtime, or a secondary endpoint
